create_jin_instances.description: Creates a bounded parent-owned sequence of JIN subtask instances.
rules: Split your current assignment into sequential subtasks, including from a child instance. IDs must be consecutive integers starting at 1 and every conditions value must be non-empty. The runtime assigns authoritative instance and session IDs. Your group suspends your execution until all its children finish; results return to you, the immediate parent. CREATE ends the current action batch: wait for the next runtime tick before further actions. Nested groups share a configured execution budget.
